## Phase 2 — implementation notes

**D1** — `pytest_partitions.py` (284 ln) + `pytest_partitions.txt` (4 lines:
`tests/ops tests/e2e` · `docs/build/tools` · `tests/db` · `*`). The runner
validates the table (overlap/nesting/missing/out-of-`testpaths`/0-or-2 `*`
→ exit 2), spawns four pytest processes with per-partition `--basetemp`,
log+rc files and a scrubbed env (`PYTEST_PARTITIONS_CMD` is the test seam,
never wired into CI or the Makefile), replays logs in `::group::`s, and
exits 0 only when every rc is 0 AND every log carries a `passed` summary —
rc 5, a missing rc file, or rc 0 without the summary are red. Two measured
table constraints are recorded in the file's comments: tests/db is alone
(`from conftest import` shadowing — the api conftest produced 27 DB
collection errors when co-located), and tests/connectors stays in `*` for
serial warm-up (its tracemalloc-growth test fails cold).
`make test-par` added; `make test` stays serial; `ci-local` and the
`python` job's Test step run `test-par` (env block unchanged).

**D2** — `perf_reuse.py` (≈300 ln, contract §3 verbatim semantics):
`fingerprint` SHA-256s NUL-joined `ls-tree -r -z` entries outside records
paths (mode+type+oid+path, so mode-only changes count; `docs/build/tools`
is NOT records — it is CI code and always invalidates). `decide` answers
`reuse` only when all nine contract conditions hold (event, same-repo,
fresh fingerprint match, strict nine-key `key=value` record at
`$CI_RECORD`, nonrecords+pr match, no symlink/gitlink, coupling lint,
image match); every other shape — including any exception — fails closed
to `run` with a `ci-perf-run`/`ci-perf-reuse` notice + step-summary line.
`record` writes the nine-line `sig.perf-pass/1`/`web-perf-fixtures` record
to `$CI_RECORD_OUT` only for an exactly-two-parent HEAD with a valid
`ImageOS-ImageVersion`; exit 1 + no file otherwise. ci.yml uses the
contract's (a)–(f) verbatim: impossible `-none` restore key + `…-`
restore-keys prefix, per-run `-<run_id>-<attempt>` save keys (a cache key
is never rewritten), record/save at the END of the job gated on
`success()`, and the single `mode != 'reuse'` `if:` on `Performance
budgets`. The restore+record steps are `continue-on-error` bookkeeping;
`decide` is ungated and crash-fatal.

**D3** — ADR-219 + regenerated index, Appendix F row + spec rebuild,
ADR_TRIGGERS.csv row (215 validated), BACKLOG sources + regenerated
BACKLOG.md, AGENTS.md L59–60/L75–76 corrections + `test-par` row,
tests/AGENTS.md row, Makefile L6 header correction, ci.yml step-gating
header comment.

Size budget: ≈ 697 changed lines, under the 700 stop line (D1 ≈ 316,
D2 ≈ 381).

## Phase 3 — self-review

Mechanical: `git diff --check` clean; every new file inside § Files;
`git status` untracked set contains only allowed paths (the untracked
`docs/build/reports/digests/2026-10-20.md` is NOT this row's — excluded
from every commit). Design: the reuse decision can never change a
verdict's ground truth — it only skips a measurement whose inputs are
byte-identical, on the same image, same PR, and records the skip as a
notice; no test verdict is reused; the other four required jobs and every
non-fixture web step run on every head. Fail-closed everywhere: every
error path in `decide` answers `run`; `record` and cache steps are
best-effort only.

## OM-18 stop-and-ask — D1 contention defect

Two repair rounds are spent and two partitioned runs in a row are not
green, so per the contract (D1.6 / § Notes) the D1 wiring is reverted —
`ci.yml` `python` Test step back to `make test`, `ci-local` back to
`$(MAKE) test` — while the machinery, table and self-tests stay
committed and proven. Evidence: run 39534265940 partition-4 and run
39535629010 partition-3 both failed ONLY on
`test_memory_is_bounded_by_one_capture`'s tracemalloc growth comparison
(bounded ≈22 B/page vs a NEGATIVE unbounded delta — allocation-history
measurement flake under four-way contention; the dedicated
acceptance+api warm-up leg did not fix it; the test also failed a local
serial run under parallel load while the base's serial CI passes it).
The operator chooses: "keep serial and land D2 only" vs "continue"
(e.g. quarantining that one test or accepting a rerun budget).
